gym.name: Gym Membership
gym.blurb: You paid for the membership, so you will go at least twice.

doctor_visit.name: Doctor's Visit
doctor_visit.blurb: A stranger poked you, pronounced you mostly fine, and billed you for it.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.blurb: You sat very still and thought about nothing, which you are told is the point.

library.name: Library Visit
library.blurb: Free books, a silence you respect, and a reminder that you once meant to read more.

vacation.name: Vacation
vacation.blurb: A week somewhere warm, followed by a credit card statement that ruins the glow.

plastic_surgery.name: Plastic Surgery
plastic_surgery.blurb: You now look like a more expensive version of yourself, give or take a face.

lottery_ticket.name: Lottery Ticket
lottery_ticket.blurb: A small bet on a future you will not get, bought with the usual optimism.

casino.name: Casino Night
casino.blurb: The house always wins, but tonight you were the house for a few minutes.

therapy.name: Therapy
therapy.blurb: You paid a stranger to listen to your childhood, and it was worth every cent.

diet.name: Diet
diet.blurb: Three weeks of salad, one weekend of regret, and a vague sense of self-control.

party.name: Party
party.blurb: You arrived early, stayed late, and cannot remember who the host was.

volunteer.name: Volunteer Work
volunteer.blurb: You gave up a free afternoon, which is the most expensive kind of kindness.

night_class.name: Night Class
night_class.blurb: Evening lectures on a subject you chose for reasons that seemed good at the time.

spa.name: Spa Day
spa.blurb: Someone rubbed your shoulders for an hour and you briefly forgot your mortgage.

tattoo.name: Tattoo
tattoo.blurb: A permanent decision made by an excellent sense of humour and a bad sense of timing.

skydiving.name: Skydiving
skydiving.blurb: You jumped out of a perfectly good plane, which the parachute company is grateful for.

movie.name: Movie Night
movie.blurb: Two hours in the dark, a large popcorn, and a sequel nobody asked for.

concert.name: Concert
concert.blurb: You screamed the lyrics, lost your voice, and will hear a faint ringing till Tuesday.

road_trip.name: Road Trip
road_trip.blurb: Four hundred miles, one terrible gas station burrito, and a playlist you regret.

karaoke.name: Karaoke
karaoke.blurb: You sang with total confidence and a complete absence of pitch.
